The rhetoric on X and from Elon leans overwhelmingly apocalyptic on Democrats winning.

It's a mini bubble here, but I think people forget AI is bipartisan national security priority, and that $NVDA's historic rally + AI buildout acceleration happened under the Biden admin.

Anyone can extrapolate a politician's negative view on AI to doompost indexes or that " $CRWV is going to go down".

But in all reality, even with a Democratic governor, we'll likely just see some headwinds to individual developers, and incentives like "clean-energy tax credits" moving to other areas in AI like solar manufacturing. 

Rather than any market-wide doomsday scenario that the opposing party likes to portray. 

Even Bitcoin/Ethereum performed better under the negatively perceived regulation of Gary Gensler. 

Just like any major event, everyone looks at the worst case scenario like helium disruption shutting down Samsung, $TSM, and the memory trade... 

Then markets move on few weeks later.
